thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected in us-midatlantic gateway. 3m avg 5xx = 18% (>5% threshold). Paging #oncall.

sarah: i'm on it — paging @raj and @alex. pulling up grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/ABCD/edge-overview

raj: looking... ingress pool `edge-proxy-03` shows connection errors to `mlworker-pool-7`. 502 spike at 17:23 UTC. rolling window shows sustained errors for ~4 minutes.

alex: quick curl against LB returned `HTTP/1.1 502` and intermittent `connection reset by peer`.

```
$ curl -sv https://us-mid.gateway.redwood/api/v1/health
* Connected to us-mid.gateway.redwood (10.12.3.4) port 443
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
* Connection was reset
```

sarah: seems like the upstream mlworker hosts are failing. playbook suggests failing inference traffic to a healthy region. can we kick a regional reroute to us-east1?

raj: executing reroute now:
```
./bin/reroute --src-region us-midatlantic --dest-region us-east1 --service inference --dry-run=false
```
submitted, controller responded 202. expect ~30s propagation.

ingress-monitor: notice: routing change applied — ~92% of new requests now directed to us-east1, remaining draining on us-midatlantic.

alex: scaling up us-east1 inference fleet +5 nodes to absorb burst: `terraform apply -var 'ml_workers_us_east_extra=5'` — apply started.

sarah: tracking customer impact — us-midatlantic 5xx peaked at 18%, global impact ~2.8%. notifying CS for top affected orgs.

ben: joining for escalation. @sarah, i'll take lead if this becomes sec1. please hand off after stabilization.

raj: digging into mlworker-7 host logs: repeated `TCP: connection reset` and OOM-killer entries around 17:21-17:24. suspect memory leak or runaway job on that node.

alex: activating host-level circuit breaker for mlworker-7 to stop routing new requests:
```
set-circuit-breaker --host mlworker-7 --state open
```

incident-bot: circuit-breaker opened for mlworker-7; routing controller moved traffic off that host.

sarah: post-mitigation stats: us-mid 5xx dropped from 18% -> 3% within ~2 minutes after reroute + breaker. continuing to monitor p50/p95.

ingress-monitor: latency note — p50 increased ~120ms during the reroute window but within SLO. no new 5xx spikes after breaker.

raj: starting drain and rebuild for mlworker-7: `kubectl drain node/mlworker-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -> cordon -> reprovision image with mem-safety patch.

alex: pushing hotfix branch `fix/mem-safety` to CI. deploy-bot kicked off a build.

deploy-bot: build #4321 succeeded, image pushed to registry `registry.redwood/players/mlworker:fix-mem-safety-4321`.

sarah: customer-impact summary: estimated ~0.7% of global requests experienced errors attributable to this incident; approx 1.2k active sessions impacted during peak window 17:22-17:28 UTC. CS alerted and drafting customer note.

ben: taking over incident lead at 17:35 UTC. @sarah — thanks, you can stand down. next steps: complete node rebuild, validate no regression for 1h, postmortem owner @raj.

sarah: handoff complete 17:35 UTC. mitigation tags: `mitigation=routing-to-us-east1`, `breaker=mlworker-7`, `rebuild=mlworker-7-image`, `cs-notified=yes` :thumbsup:

raj: will collect heap profiles, kube events, and kernel OOM logs for RCA. aim to publish postmortem EOD tomorrow.

ingress-monitor: final telemetry snapshot at 17:45 UTC: us-mid 5xx = 0.9%, global baseline restored. monitoring until 18:35 UTC.

ben: thanks everyone. i'll coordinate the customer communication and ensure the postmortem covers root cause and follow-up actions (auto-ban unhealthy hosts earlier, add mem cgroup limits, and improved draining docs). closing page once rebuild and 1h quiet window complete.
